segments.source: — Da.
segments.translation: “Yes.”

segments.source: Sen zâmbi. Pentru el, toate avertismentele tatălui dispărură în acel cuvânt.
segments.translation: Sen smiled. For him, all his father’s warnings disappeared into that word.

segments.source: Vessa îl aștepta afară. Îl felicită și îi ceru să vină la controlul medical săptămâna următoare. Când băiatul plecă spre colegi, se întoarse către Taren.
segments.translation: Vessa was waiting outside. She congratulated him and asked him to come for a medical examination the following week. When the boy left to join his classmates, she turned to Taren.

segments.source: — Ai încercat să-i iei numele din examen și i-ai lăsat statuia, spuse.
segments.translation: “You tried to remove his name from the examination and left him his statue,” she said.

segments.source: — Nu are statuie.
segments.translation: “He has no statue.”

segments.source: — Are una vie. Merge prin oraș și conduce Custodia.
segments.translation: “He has a living one. It walks through the city and leads the Custodianship.”

segments.source: — Ce trebuia să fac? Să-i interzic?
segments.translation: “What should I have done? Forbidden him?”

segments.source: — Nu. Trebuia să nu te prefaci că o ușă egală corectează drumul diferit până la ea.
segments.translation: “No. You should have stopped pretending that an equal door corrects the different roads leading to it.”

segments.source: Taren nu răspunse. În anii următori, avea să repete că Sen câștigase fiecare rang. Era adevărat. Nu era tot adevărul.
segments.translation: Taren did not answer. In the years that followed, he would repeat that Sen had earned every rank. It was true. It was not the whole truth.

segments.source: Programul junior combina școala cu serviciul. Copiii învățau ecologie, reparații, istorie și control corporal. În fiecare săptămână petreceau un ciclu în instituțiile civile: depozite, clinici, arhive, ferme. Ideea fusese a Savei. Voia ca Fețele să nu creadă că lumea începea la marginea armei.
segments.translation: The junior programme combined schooling with service. The children learned ecology, repairs, history and bodily control. Each week, they spent a cycle in civilian institutions: warehouses, clinics, archives, farms. The idea had been Sava’s. She wanted the Faces to understand that the world did not begin at the edge of a weapon.

segments.source: În primul an, Sen lucra la o fermă de mușchi din Ivarra. Sarcina lui era să curețe canalele fine fără să rupă filamentele nutritive. Era lent și prost la aceasta. O fată de Mâini, Deli, îi arătă cum să simtă presiunea cu degetele.
segments.translation: In his first year, Sen worked at a moss farm in Ivarra. His task was to clean the fine channels without breaking the nutrient filaments. He was slow and bad at it. A Hands girl, Deli, showed him how to feel the pressure with his fingers.

segments.source: — Nu împingi tot ce nu se mișcă, spuse ea.
segments.translation: “You do not push everything that refuses to move,” she said.

segments.source: — Nu împing.
segments.translation: “I am not pushing.”

segments.source: — Canalul spune altceva.
segments.translation: “The channel says otherwise.”

segments.source: El încercă din nou. La sfârșitul zilei, rupsese mai puține rădăcini decât dimineața. Instructorul îi acordă scor mediu. În raportul public, episodul apăru ca dovadă a modestiei fiului Custodelui. Deli nu fu menționată.
segments.translation: He tried again. By the end of the day, he was breaking fewer roots than that morning. The instructor gave him an average score. In the public report, the episode appeared as evidence of the Custodian’s son’s humility. Deli was not mentioned.

segments.source: — Spune-le că ea m-a învățat, ceru Sen.
segments.translation: “Tell them she taught me,” Sen insisted.

segments.source: — Nu controlăm rapoartele, răspunse instructorul.
segments.translation: “We do not control the reports,” the instructor replied.

segments.source: Sen merse la Memorie și depuse corecția. Nemi o acceptă. Înregistrarea deveni populară: tânărul Feței care își recunoștea profesoara de Mâini. Deli primi o invitație la academie, dar familia ei avea nevoie de ea la fermă și o refuză. Sen nu află decât după ani. În poveste, egalitatea funcționase.
segments.translation: Sen went to Memory and submitted the correction. Nemi accepted it. The recording became popular: the young Face acknowledging his Hands teacher. Deli received an invitation to the academy, but her family needed her at the farm, and she declined. Sen did not find out until years later. In the story, equality had worked.

segments.source: La doisprezece ani fu trimis într-o patrulă de transport, oficial ca observator. Nivarii ajungeau repede la maturitate, iar generațiile de criză împinseseră vârsta serviciului și mai jos. Corpul lui Sen era aproape adult; judecata lui nu era.
segments.translation: At twelve, he was sent on a transport patrol, officially as an observer. Nivari matured quickly, and the crisis generations had driven the age of service lower still. Sen’s body was almost adult; his judgement was not.

segments.source: Convoiul ducea hrană către o comunitate fără registru de la marginea Nopții. Localnicii furaseră două vagoane în sezonul precedent și Custodia îi clasificase drept risc. Comandantul patrulei, Varo, voia să păstreze jumătate din rații până când comunitatea preda hoții.
segments.translation: The convoy was taking food to an unregistered community at the edge of Night. The locals had stolen two wagons the previous season, and the Custodianship had classified them as a risk. The patrol commander, Varo, wanted to retain half the rations until the community handed over the thieves.

segments.source: Sen citi manifestul. Copiii primeau deja mai puțin decât necesarul.
segments.translation: Sen read the manifest. The children were already receiving less than they needed.

segments.source: — Codul interzice folosirea hranei împotriva civililor, spuse.
segments.translation: “The Code forbids using food against civilians,” he said.

segments.source: — Codul interzice pedeapsa colectivă, răspunse Varo. Aceasta este garanție logistică.
segments.translation: “The Code forbids collective punishment,” Varo replied. “This is a logistical guarantee.”

segments.source: — Care este diferența pentru cei care nu mănâncă?
segments.translation: “What is the difference for those who do not eat?”

segments.source: — Intenția și condiția de restituire.
segments.translation: “The intention and the condition for restitution.”

segments.source: Sen deschise canalul Custodiei. Varo îi închise terminalul.
segments.translation: Sen opened the Custodianship channel. Varo shut down his terminal.

segments.source: — Ești observator.
segments.translation: “You are an observer.”

segments.source: — Pot raporta încălcarea.
segments.translation: “I can report the violation.”

segments.source: — Poți raporta după misiune.
segments.translation: “You can report it after the mission.”

segments.source: În așezare, oamenii ieșiră din tuneluri slabi și înarmați cu unelte. Varo își desfășură Fețele. Un bărbat bătrân spuse că hoții muriseră în viscol. Nu avea corpuri; le mâncaseră vânătorii de margine.
segments.translation: In the settlement, people emerged from the tunnels, thin and armed with tools. Varo deployed his Faces. An old man said the thieves had died in the blizzard. He had no bodies; edge hunters had eaten them.

segments.source: — Atunci datoria rămâne la comunitate, spuse Varo.
segments.translation: “Then the debt remains with the community,” Varo said.

segments.source: Sen văzu copiii privind vagoanele. Își aminti de taberele Iernii Albe, pe care le cunoștea numai din înregistrări și din tăcerile adulților.
segments.translation: Sen saw the children watching the wagons. He remembered the White Winter camps, which he knew only from recordings and adults’ silences.

segments.source: — Eu garantez transportul, spuse.
segments.translation: “I will guarantee the shipment,” he said.

segments.source: Varo râse.
segments.translation: Varo laughed.

segments.source: — Cu ce?
segments.translation: “With what?”

segments.source: — Cu cota mea de familie și cu plata de serviciu până se acoperă pierderea.
segments.translation: “My family quota and my service pay until the loss is covered.”

segments.source: — Nu ajunge.
segments.translation: “It is not enough.”

segments.source: — Atunci notează că ai refuzat o garanție și ai păstrat hrana.
segments.translation: “Then record that you refused a guarantee and kept the food.”

segments.source: Varo îl privi lung. Nu se temea de băiat, dar se temea de numele pe care procedura anonimă nu-l putuse șterge. Descărcă toate vagoanele.
segments.translation: Varo looked at him for a long time. He did not fear the boy, but he feared the name the anonymous procedure had been unable to erase. He unloaded every wagon.

segments.source: Raportul îl lăudă pe Sen pentru „mediere”. Varo primi o mustrare și fu promovat în anul următor. Comunitatea restitui o treime din hrană; restul nu mai fu cerut. Sen învăță că legea putea proteja slabul atunci când cineva puternic o rostea. Nu învăță cum suna aceeași lege din gura cuiva fără nume.
segments.translation: The report praised Sen for “mediation”. Varo received a reprimand and was promoted the following year. The community repaid a third of the food; the rest was no longer demanded. Sen learned that the law could protect the weak when someone powerful spoke it. He did not learn how the same law sounded in the mouth of someone without a name.

segments.source: La paisprezece ani conducea patrule scurte. Era riguros. Își împărțea hrana egal, dormea ultimul și interzicea trofeele. Când un membru al unității lovi un prizonier, îl scoase din serviciu chiar dacă era fiul unei Case influente. Povestea se răspândi. Fețele tinere îl iubeau nu pentru blândețe, ci pentru faptul că regula lui putea umili pe oricine.
segments.translation: At fourteen, he led short patrols. He was rigorous. He shared his food equally, slept last and forbade trophies. When a member of his unit struck a prisoner, he removed him from service even though he was the son of an influential House. The story spread. The young Faces loved him not for his gentleness, but because his rule could humble anyone.
